title: Bostitch Office B175-BLK Heavy Duty 40-Sheet Flat Clinch Stapler, Pack of 9

comparisons.notes: Single B175-BLK 40-sheet flat clinch stapler, black, $12.99 each, in stock; price shown is 9 x $12.99 to match Woot's 9-pack

writeup: Woot has a 9-pack of Bostitch Office B175-BLK heavy-duty flat clinch staplers for $25.90, about $2.88 per stapler. Each one staples up to 40 sheets with flat-clinch staples that keep stacks neat. Bostitch's own store sells a single B175-BLK for $12.99, so nine would cost $116.91 there. Limit 10 per customer.
